Also, it mentions momentum dependence enabling probing at different length scales, beyond a single bound, and that QFI quantifies momentum-dependent degree of entanglement depth.

So the escalation might be based on a misunderstanding: A says "goes beyond" implying it is more than just a lower bound, while B says it's simultaneously a lower bound and a momentum-resolved probe, which is compatible because being a momentum-resolved probe is indeed beyond just providing a single lower bound. 3. Emphasize that the lower bound property holds for any wave vector, so the momentum resolution is an extension.
